title: Nutty AeriZed Canadian Eggplant Gratin
description: A sophisticated Canadian eggplant dish featuring a nutty, aerated gratin. Perfect for a date night dinner.
instructions: Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and scoop out the flesh, leaving 1/2 inch of flesh around the skin.
In a large bowl, combine the eggplant flesh, nutmeg, salt, and black pepper. Toss to coat.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and butter until well combined.
Add the chicken broth to the flour mixture and whisk until smooth.
Add the heavy cream and whisk until well combined.
Stir in 1/2 cup of the grated cheddar cheese.
Place the eggplant halves in a baking dish and pour the cream mixture over them.
Top with the remaining 1/2 cup of grated cheddar cheese and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
